主要内容: On February 21, 2013, Butler Animal Health Supply, LLC, a majority-owned subsidiary of Henry Schein, Inc., repaid all outstanding obligations under the Butler Credit Agreement. The Butler Credit Agreement, dated December 31, 2009, and amended on December 21, 2010, and May 27, 2011, provided for a $50 million revolving credit facility, a $100 million term loan scheduled to mature in December 2014, and a $216 million term loan scheduled to mature in December 2015. The agreement was terminated after the repayment. This action reflects the company's financial management and debt restructuring efforts. Henry Schein, Inc. is the parent company of Butler, and the event is relevant to its healthcare distribution operations and financial structure. The termination of the credit agreement indicates a significant financial milestone for Butler and its parent company, impacting both the company and the broader healthcare distribution industry.
